REPORT ON Prosecution of Yeu Yoeh Tsz (俞育之 )
Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by W. Givens A.S.
Sir,
In view of the abdication of H. E. President Hsu
Shih Chang, I respectfully beg to suggest that the chances of
obtaining a conviction against Yeu Yoeh Tsz (俞育之 ),
President of the Association of All Societies in the Chinese
Republic for publishing an inflammatory handbill referring
to ex-President Hsu are considerably lessened, and I beg to
ask for instructions as to whether the prosecution is to be
gone on with or not. The summons has not been served.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Sullivan.
D. I.
D. C. I.

May 29, 1922. 192

REPORT ON Seditious declaration against President.

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

Acting on a Search warrant issued by the Mixed Court
I searched the headquarters of the Association of All
Societies of the Chinese Republic, 424 Mohawk Road on May 25
1922, and found several copies of the original draft of the
attached seditious circular. There are slight alterations
in the circular and if anything the original draft is even
more seditious than the finished article.

Whilst at the headquarters of the above society on the
afternoon of May 27 I endeavoured, unsuccessfully, to
discover who wrote the circular.

It was, however, admitted by several members of the
Society that the publication of the circular was decided
upon at a meeting of the society held at its headquarters
on May 13 and presided over by Yeu Yeoh Tsz (喻育之),
President of the National Organizations Union Of China, and
ex-President of the Shanghai Students Union. The secretary
to the meeting was Doong Li Tsang (董里章) of the Merchants
and Labourers Mutual Aid Society, 9 Mei Lung Lee (美倫里)
Shantung Road.

I therefore respectfully beg to suggest that Yeu Yoeh
Tsz (喻育之) be summoned to appear before the Mixed Court
when the application is made to close the association.

I am,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
D. I.

D. C. I.

先生，

依据会审公廨签发的搜查令，我于1922年5月25日搜查了位于莫霍克路（Mohawk Road，即北四川路）424号的“中华民国各团体联合会”总部，并发现了数份所附煽动性传单的原始草稿副本。该传单略有改动，若有什么不同的话，原始草稿甚至比定稿更具煽动性。

5月27日下午，我在上述协会总部时，曾试图查明是谁撰写了该传单，但未获成功。

然而，该协会数名成员承认，发布该传单的决定是在5月13日于其总部举行的协会会议上作出的，会议由“中国全国组织联合会”主席、前上海学生联合会主席喻育之（Yeu Yeoh Tsz）主持。会议秘书为山东路美伦里9号“商工互助社”的董里章（Doong Li Tsang）。

因此，本人谨建议在申请关闭该协会时，传唤喻育之（Yeu Yoeh Tsz）到会审公廨出庭。

此致，
敬礼

[签名]
警探长 (D. I.)

副总监 (D. C. I.)

上海国际会审公廨
刑事管辖权
（印：会审公廨登记簿 第11886号）
致上海警务处处长及本庭其他官员

上海公共租界工部局警务处委员今日提出控告，称涉嫌并相信题为“我们反对外滩银行团”（We stand against The Bunded）的传单副本被藏匿于北四川路苏宗里（Suez Jung Li）424号 premises 内的“中华民国所有苏维埃”（all Soviets in the Chinese Republic，原文如此）手中，违反《中华民国暂行新刑律》第221条，且上述控告人已申请搜查令以进入所述处所搜查并扣押所述传单。

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
I. O. REG
No. 4578
Date 12/4/22

The following is the statement of Zung Chu Fung ( 鄭秋朋 )
native of Canton taken by me D. I. Givens
at C.I.D. headqrs on the May 23 1922 and interpreted by Inter. Koo

My name is Zung Chu Fung ( 鄭秋朋 ). I am a native of
Canton. I am employed as an apprentice in the Intelligence
Press (民智印刷所), No. 138 Rue Hue. On a date that I can
not remember, a "boy" from the Association of All Societies in
the Chinese Republic came to our shop, and ordered a thousand
copies of an article contained in a cutting from a newspaper
which he handed to the proprietor of the shop. The newspaper
cutting was contained in an envelope on which the name of the
society was printed. The article was duly printed in
handbill form. These handbills were seized by the French
Police a few days ago.

Signed by 鄭秋朋 in the presence
of Int. Koo.

I. O. REG

以下为郑秋朋（Zung Chu Fung），广东籍人士，于1922年5月23日在刑事侦缉处总部由我（警探长 Givens）录取，并由翻译顾（Koo）口译的供词：

我叫郑秋朋（Zung Chu Fung）。我是广东人。我在霞飞路（Rue Hue）138号民智印刷所（Intelligence Press）当学徒。在一个我记不清的日子，一名来自“中华民国各团体联合会”的“小伙计”来到我们店里，向店主订购一千份刊登在他递交给店主的报纸剪报中的文章。报纸剪报装在一个信封里，信封上印有该协会的名称。该文章随后被 duly 印刷成传单形式。这些传单几天前被法国巡捕查获。

郑秋朋 在翻译顾（Int. Koo）面前签署。

REPORT ON Printing and Publication of Seditious Declaration
Against President.

Made by D. I. Sivens Forwarded by

Sir,

With reference to the seizure by the French Police
on May 19 in the Intelligence Press(民智印刷所) Printing
Establishment, No. 138-140 Rue Roe, of a bundle of circulars
denouncing the President, which had been printed on the order
of the Association of All Societies in the Chinese Republic,
this denunciation appeared in the Min Kuo Pao on May 14.
Arrangements are being made to get statements proving that
the declaration originated from the Association of all
Societies in the Chinese Republic, and in the meantime I
respectfully beg to apply for instructions as to whether
the Min Kuo Pao should be prosecuted.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I.

D. C. I.

先生，

关于法国巡捕于5月19日在霞飞路（Rue Roe，原文如此，应为Rue Hue或附近街道）138-140号民智印刷所（Intelligence Press）印刷厂查获的一批谴责总统的传单一事，这些传单是受“中华民国各团体联合会”委托印刷的，该谴责文章见于5月14日的《民国报》。目前正在安排获取证据，以证明该宣言源自“中华民国各团体联合会”。在此期间，本人谨请示是否应对《民国报》提起诉讼。

pages.en:
The original of this was sent to me from French
Police who found it in a junkers shop which has
been raided :

No. 4578
Date 12/6/22

Translation of a Declaration issued on
May 13, 1922 by the Association of
All Societies of the Chinese Republic.

To all public bodies, newspapers, and citizens of
all classes, in all provinces, special
districts, Chinese colonies, Inner and Outer
Mongolia, Singkiang and Thibet.

The undersigned association to-day issues the
following offences of Hsu Shih Chang.

The whole country is indignant over the
wicked offences hitherto committed by Hsu Shih
Chang. In order to fortify himself he recently
instigated the Chili-Fengtien strife, and
retained his illegal title by sacrifising the
lives and property of the citizens for it.
Prior to the opening of hostilities between the
Chili and Fengtien factions, Hsu was afraid
that his own position would be affected, and
consequently he dispatched telegrams to Tsao Kun,
Wu Pei Fu and Chang Tso Lin begging for mercy
and protection. His shameful action is thus
shown. He remarked at the conclusion of his
telegram that his advice and opinion was not
of any value to outsiders. He thus very truly
criticised himself. Hsu is a remnant of the
Tsing Dynasty, but now he steals and holds the
political power of the Republic. He is greedy
for money and power, is old and lives shamefully.
He is practically in a state of mourning and
at the point of death. He often speaks of his
position and as having been elected by the
people. As a matter of fact the contrary
is proved. We will not be satisfied as long as
he remains alive. The citizens are not mere
insensible stones. Why should they be willing
to allow him to keep on doing wrong ? We now
disclose all of his offences for the information
of the whole country.

(1) After the revolution in 1921, Hsu fled
and hid himself in Tsingtau. During that time he
was in constant communication with the Tsong Zai
Tang (宗社党). He afterwards became Premier
under President Yuan Shih Kai immediately following
the break up of the Parliament by Yuan in the 2nd
year of the Republic. Plots during that time were
all hatched by Hsu. The monarchical movement
was also advocated by Hsu who made his plans in
conjunction with Liang Shih Yi. He, however,
was in great fear when Feng Kuo Chang threatened
to take steps on Liang sending out a telegram
seeking support from the various provinces.
Immediately afterwards he obtained leave of
absence. He continued to plot secretly till
the death of Yuan Shih Kai. Thus his first offence
was helping the wrong party in the hope of
plotting an uprising to cause a change in the
National Government.

（左侧手写批注）：
SC!
Hsin's necessary
statement for
French Police
whereafter presented
& ask for a Comt.
order closing the
Association.

20
5/22
pages.zh:
原件由法国巡捕送交给我，他们是在一次突袭行动中的一家旧货店（junkers shop）里发现它的：

编号 4578
日期 1922年6月12日

中华民国各团体联合会于
1922年5月13日发布的宣言译文。

致各省、特别区、华侨聚居地、内外蒙古、新疆及西藏的所有公共机构、报纸及各阶层公民。

本协会今日公布徐世昌的以下罪状。

举国上下对徐世昌迄今所犯的邪恶罪行感到愤慨。为了巩固自己的地位，他最近挑起了直奉战争，并以牺牲公民的生命财产为代价来保留其非法头衔。在直奉两派开战之前，徐担心自己的地位受到影响，因此致电曹锟、吴佩孚和张作霖，乞求怜悯和保护。其可耻行径由此暴露。他在电文结尾称，他的建议和意见对外人毫无价值。他 thus 非常真实地批评了自己。徐是清朝的残余分子，但现在却窃取并把持着民国的政治权力。他贪财恋权，年老而生活无耻。他实际上处于守丧状态，且濒临死亡。他常谈论自己的职位，声称是由人民选举产生的。事实上，情况恰恰相反。只要他还活着，我们就不会满意。公民并非没有知觉的石头。他们为何愿意让他继续作恶？我们现在揭露他的所有罪行，以供全国知晓。

(1) 1921年革命后，徐逃往青岛躲藏。在此期间，他与宗社党保持频繁联系。随后，在民国二年袁世凯解散国会后，他成为袁世凯总统下的总理。当时的阴谋均由徐策划。帝制运动也是由徐倡导的，他与梁士诒共同制定计划。然而，当冯国璋威胁要采取行动，梁士诒发出通电寻求各省支持时，他感到非常恐惧。随即他请假离职。他继续秘密策划，直到袁世凯去世。因此，他的第一项罪行是帮助错误的一方，企图策划起义以改变国家政府。

（左侧手写批注）：
SC!
Hsin's necessary
statement for
French Police
whereafter presented
& ask for a Comt.
order closing the
Association.

20
5/22

pages.en:
(2) After the death of Yuan Shih Kai, Parliament
was restored, and a government established, and the
whole country expected that the government
would rule the country properly. Contrary to
all expectations Hsu again instigated a plot.
He persuaded Nylen Sz Tsong to invade the capital,
and established an illegal General Staff Head-
quarters at Tientsin. The cause of all trouble
was the suggestion that he (Hsu) should be elected
President. However his anticipation was not
realised owing to the action of the Tientsin Consular
Body. His 2nd offence was therefore the breaking
of the National Constitution and the instigation
of internal war.

(3) Immediately after his failure to get elected
as President, he instigated Chang Hsun to start a
monarchical restoration movement. He requested
that he should be appointed Prince Regent. Before
false orders could be published the movement died
out. His 3rd offence was therefore his attempt to
abolish the Republican Government and to give
assistance to restore the Manchu Regime.

(4) After his plan to make himself Prince
Regent proved a failure, he took advantage of the
opportunity when Feng Kuo Chang and Tuan Chi Jui
were opposing each other, to buy over the
illegal organization (? the new Parliament),
thus he claims to be President and stays in the
Metropolitan City. This shows that he has not
observed the law and has betrayed the people.

(5) The conclusion of the agreement for
the Twenty-One Demands was due to allowing
Tuan Shih Kai to make himself Emperor. At that
time Hsu Shih Chang, who was acting as Prime
Minister, approved of Yuan's action.
Subsequently when Hsu Shih Chang was desirous
of being illegally elected President, he
directed Tsao Yu Ling to sell by auction
the Kao-Zee and Zung-Uhi Railways. This has
caused numerous diplomatic complications and
proved him to be a betrayer of the country
and a flatterer of foreigners.

(6) The Republic of China consists of
five races and both the southerners and
northerners are of one family; therefore
the people have for a long time been
desirous of having the country united.
A peace conference was held in the 8th year
(1919) of the Republic between the Southern
and Northern Delegates. The first question
brought up at the conference was the
cancellation of Hsu Shih Chang's so-called
Presidency. However Hsu Shih Chang declined
to vacate the position. Since then three
years have elapsed, during which the South
and North have been fighting one another.
He is indeed the obstructor of the unification
of the country.
pages.zh:
(2) 袁世凯死后，国会恢复，政府成立，举国期待政府能妥善治理国家。与所有预期相反，徐再次策划阴谋。他劝说倪嗣冲入侵首都，并在天津建立了非法的总参谋部总部。所有麻烦的根源在于建议选举他（徐）为总统。然而，由于天津领事团的行动，他的期望未能实现。因此，他的第二项罪行是破坏国家宪法并煽动内战。

(3) 在他当选总统失败后，他立即煽动张勋发起君主复辟运动。他请求任命自己为摄政王。在伪令发布之前，该运动便已平息。因此，他的第三项罪行是企图废除共和政府并协助恢复满清政权。

(4) 在他自立为摄政王的计划失败后，他利用冯国璋和段祺瑞相互对立的机会，收买非法组织（？新国会），从而自称总统并留在京城。这表明他不守法纪，背叛人民。

(5) 《二十一条》协议的达成，是由于允许袁世凯称帝。当时担任总理的徐世昌批准了袁的行动。后来，当徐世昌希望被非法选举为总统时，他指示曹汝霖拍卖高济铁路和中乌铁路（Kao-Zee and Zung-Uhi Railways，音译）。这造成了无数外交纠纷，证明他是卖国贼和外国的谄媚者。

(6) 中华民国由五族组成，南北方本是一家；因此，人民长期以来渴望国家统一。民国八年（1919年），南方和北方代表举行了和平会议。会议上提出的第一个问题是取消徐世昌所谓的总统职位。然而，徐世昌拒绝 vacate 该职位。此后三年过去了，期间南北双方互相争斗。他确实是国家统一的阻碍者。

pages.en:
(7) To-day's militarists are former militarists.
Formerly they observed the law but at present they
pay no heed to it. Their boldness is due to Hsu's indulgence. At first he used Tuan Chi Jui
as a tool in overthrowing Feng Kuo Chang,
after which he made Wu Pei Fu overthrow Tuan Chi
Jui. Subsequently he engaged Chang Tso Lin
to fight Wu Pei Fu and now he has used Wu Pei
Fu to resist Chang Tso Lin. He is the chief
culprit in instigating civil war.

(8) When Hsu was Governor-General of the three
Eastern Provinces he used in two months $10,000,000
which was in the bank. Since his occupation of
the presidency, foreign loan and national loan
amounting to $100,000,000, custom surplus, Salt surplus,
tobacco surplus, Railway surplus, and other annual
incomes to a total amount of $50,000,000 have all
gone into his own pocket. During the Chin Dynasty
the annual expenditure of the country was
$30,000,000. Although the expenditure is now much
larger, he never gives us any definite account
of how it is expended. He has evidently devoted
it to the supply of traitors, the military men
and other sources of a selfish end. Now there
is no clear account of expenditure. Debts are
becoming larger and larger, but Hsu is not worried
in the least, and is prepared to be a rich man
of a degraded nation. He offered the national
property to others.

(9) Hsu was brought up in a family of scholastic
nature and knows nothing about municipal administration
or history of the world. Instead of encouraging
education he kills it. He puts a check to
Municipal Administration. In industry he only encourages
speculation. In carrying out his statistics he
follows the example of the unscrupulous merchants.
The way Yuan Shih Kai brought disaster to the country
was like a plague which makes a man jump about,
to suffer painfully, and to die a sudden death,
but Hsu's way of bringing disaster to the country
is like a disease which makes men thinner and thinner
day by day and die a gradual death. Although
their ways of endangering the country are different
it has exactly the same end.

(10) As stated above, Hsu first served in the
Manchu Court. After the Manchus were overthrown,
he was made Imperial Tutor to the ex-Emperor and
was in close touch with the pro-Manchu members.
At the same time he was Premier to Yuan Shih Kai
and supported the monarchical movement. After
this, he attempted to make himself Generalissimo.
This also failed. He then endeavoured to become
Prince Regent but again failing, he took up the
position of illegal President and enjoyed himself.
He, however, did not give up his position as
Imperial Tutor to the Manchu Court. In the 7th year
when he was elected President, he went to the Manchu
Palace and kneeling before the ex-Emperor, asked
permission to take up the Presidency. On the New
Year Day of the 8th year of the Republic he begged
the ex-Emperor for the issue of "Foh and Sau"
(Happiness and Long Life) in his own hand writing.
pages.zh:
(7) 今日的军阀即昔日的军阀。
昔日他们尚遵守法律，但如今却置若罔闻。他们的猖狂是由于徐世昌的纵容。起初他利用段祺瑞作为推翻冯国璋的工具，
随后又使吴佩孚推翻了段祺瑞。此后他又雇用张作霖攻打吴佩孚，如今又利用吴佩孚来抵抗张作霖。他是煽动内战的首恶。

(8) 徐世昌担任东三省总督期间，在两个月内挥霍了银行中的1,000万美元。自其就任总统以来，外债和国债共计1亿美元，关余、盐余、
烟税余利、路余以及其他年收入总计5,000万美元，全部落入其私囊。清朝时期，国家每年的支出为
3,000万美元。虽然现在的支出大得多，但他从未向我们提供明确的开支账目。显然，他将这些款项用于供养叛徒、
军人及其他满足私欲的途径。现在没有清晰的支出账目。债务日益增加，但徐世昌毫不担忧，并准备做一个亡国富翁。他将国家财产拱手让人。

(9) 徐世昌出身于书香门第，对市政管理或世界历史一无所知。他不仅不鼓励教育，反而扼杀教育。他阻碍
市政管理。在工业方面，他只鼓励投机。在进行统计工作时，他效仿无良商人的做法。袁世凯给国家带来灾难的方式
如同瘟疫，使人痛苦挣扎，突然死亡；而徐世昌给国家带来灾难的方式则如同一种疾病，使人日渐消瘦，缓慢死亡。虽然
他们危害国家的方式不同，但结果完全相同。

(10) 如上所述，徐世昌最初在满清朝廷任职。满清被推翻后，他被任命为废帝的帝师，并与亲满分子保持密切联系。
同时，他担任袁世凯的总理，并支持君主立宪运动。此后，他试图让自己成为大元帅。这也失败了。随后他努力成为摄政王，但再次失败，于是他担任了非法总统一职并自得其乐。然而，他并未放弃其作为满清朝廷帝师的职位。在他当选总统的第七年，他前往满清皇宫，跪在废帝面前，请求允许他就任总统。在民国八年元旦，他恳求废帝御笔亲书“福寿”二字。

pages.en:
He wrote a book at Sai Hai Palace entitled
"History of the Imperial Tutor." He is receiving
pay as Tutor to the ex-Emperor and was recently
given the additional rank of Imperial Guardian.
He is between the "three"and "four" (means no
suitable term can be given to a man of such a
nature) and neither a horse nor a donkey. He is
a Minister of the late Manchu regime and the
root of evil of the Republic. He steals books
from the Cabinets Library and created the Tobacco
and Wine Monopoly Bureau as his "treasury office".
He sells officials ranks, and takes money from
any source. There are ten vacancies for
"Ting Chars" in the Cabinet which have never been
filled but their pay of $400 has been drawn by him.
He is worse than Feng Kuo Chang who sold fish
kept in the Sai Hai Palace. His moral and
political wickedness cannot be compared with
that of any human being and cannot be described
by any word in the dictionary.
The above are his ten serious offences.
Any person who commits one of those offences
is despised by others and unexcusable by law.
How can Hsu be excused as there are ten serious
offences against him. Who has the determination
to take hold of the bridle and drive the car in
order to clear away (the evils)? Out off the
mast (as a signal to rise?). There are ways to
cause the downfall of the "Zing" Kingdom (Zing
was the Emperor who built the Great Wall).
Citizens! All jointly devise means.

他在西海宫写了一本书，题为《帝师历史》。他领取着废帝太傅的薪俸，最近又被加封为太保衔。他介于“三”和“四”之间（意指对于这种性质的人无法给出合适的称谓），非马非驴。他是前满清政权的臣子，也是民国的祸根。他从内阁图书馆偷窃书籍，并设立烟酒公卖局作为他的“财政办公室”。他卖官鬻爵，来者不拒地收钱。内阁中有十个“听差”的空缺从未填补，但其400美元的薪水却被他领走。他比贩卖西海宫所养之鱼的冯国璋更糟糕。他的道德和政治罪恶无法与任何人相比，也无法用字典中的任何词语来形容。
以上是他的十大严重罪行。
任何人犯下其中一项罪行都会受人鄙视，且法律不容宽恕。徐世昌身负十大重罪，怎能被宽恕？谁有决心执辔驾车以清除（邪恶）？断桅（作为起义的信号？）。有办法导致“秦”王朝的灭亡（秦是修建长城的皇帝）。
公民们！共同策划对策。

Despite the fact that he is a wicked
remnant of the ruined Tsing Dynasty, Hsu
Shih Chang, the national thief, now steals the
political power of the Republic. He has
caused disturbances in the country and calamity
to the people. Everybody is angry at his
actions. Recently he instigated bad feeling
between the Chili and Fengtien factions thereby
starting an internal war which has greatly
menaced the state of affairs. It is calculated
that this evil man has committed out of
all actions that will bring disaster to the
country, ten important offences which are
mentioned below. It is hereby proposed that
a circular telegram in the name of this Associa-
tion be dispatched throughout the whole country
with a view to enlightening the people in the
matter, and that this proposal be discussed as
to whether it can be carried out or not.
Proposed by Tung Foh Kai 董福開 .
Seconded by -

(10) As stated above, Hsu first served in
the Manchu Court. After the Manchus were
overthrown, he was made Imperial Tutor to the
Ex-Emperor and was in close touch with the pro-
Manchu members. At the same time he was Premier
to Yuan Shih Kai and supported the monarchical
movement. After this, he attempted to make
himself Generalissimo. This also failed. He
then endeavoured to become Prince Regent but
again failing, he took up the position of
illegal President and enjoyed himself. He,
however, did not give up his position as Imperial
Tutor to the Manchu Court. In the 7th year when
he was elected President, he went to the Manchu
Palace and kneeling before the ex-Emperor, asked
permission to take up the Presidency. On New
Year Day of the 8th year of the Republic he begged
the ex-Emperor for the issue of "Foh and Seu"
(Happiness and Long Life) in his own hand
writing. He wrote a book at Sai Hai Palace
entitled history of the Imperial Tutor. He is
receiving pay as Tutor to the ex-Emperor and
was recently given the additional rank of
Imperial Guardian. He is between the "Three"
and "Four" (means no suitable term can be given
to a man of such a nature) and neither a horse
nor a donkey. Neither can we say that he is
not a human being, for he has the appearance of a
man, nor that he is a human being, for nobody
would act as he has done. No word can be found
in the dictionary to describe him exactly.
He is indeed a wicked remnant of the Tsing
Dynasty and the source of disasters to the
Republic. It is said that Yuan Shih Kai's

尽管徐世昌是已灭亡的清朝的邪恶残余，这位国贼如今窃取了民国的政治权力。他
造成了国家的动荡和人民的灾难。每个人都对他的行为感到愤怒。最近他煽动直系和奉系派系之间的不和，从而
引发了一场内战，极大地威胁了局势。据估算，这个恶人犯下了所有会给国家带来灾难的行为中的十项重要罪行，下文将予以列举。兹提议以本协会的名义向全国发送通电，旨在以此事启迪民众，并讨论此提议是否可行。
提案人：董福開。
附议人 -

(10) 如上所述，徐世昌最初在满清朝廷任职。满清被推翻后，
他被任命为废帝的帝师，并与亲满
成员保持密切联系。同时，他担任袁世凯的总理，并支持君主立宪运动。
此后，他试图让自己成为大元帅。这也失败了。他
随后努力成为摄政王，但再次失败，于是他担任了
非法总统一职并自得其乐。然而，他并未放弃其作为
满清朝廷帝师的职位。在他当选总统的第七年，他前往满清
皇宫，跪在废帝面前，请求允许他就任总统。在民国八年元旦，他恳求
废帝御笔亲书“福寿”
(Happiness and Long Life) 二字。他在西海宫
写了一本书，题为《帝师历史》。他
领取着废帝太傅的薪俸，最近又被加封为
太保衔。他介于“三”
和“四”之间（意指对于这种性质的人无法给出合适的称谓），非马非驴。我们也不能说他不是人，因为他有人类的外表；也不能说他是人，因为没有人会像他那样行事。字典中找不到确切的词语来形容他。
他确实是清朝的邪恶残余，也是民国灾难的源头。据说袁世凯的

pages.en:
followers were all cunning fellows while Hsu
Shih Chang's followers are all shameful
people. During the Han Dynasty, the custom
was simple and human morals highly respected
and upheld, but after Zau Men Tuh( a traitorous
Minister) encouraged the people to be shameless,
most of the people became animal like. This
continued for 7 or 8 hundred years when the
Sung Dynasty began to restore the respectability
of human morals. Hsu Shih Chang was a court
official of the Tsing Dynasty and now he
shamelessly holds the power of the Republic.
He is a bad thief, cunning and tricky. His
entry to political circles was merely by
chance and bribery. He does not care for
morals, shame or respectability. He steals
books from the Cabinet's library and created
the Tobacco and Wine Monopoly Bureau as his
"treasury office". He sells official ranks
and takes money from any source. There are
twenty vacancies for "T'ingch'ais" in the
Cabinet which have never been filled but their
pay of $400 has been drawn by him. He is
worse than Feng Kuo Chang who sold fish
kept in the Sai Hai Palace. He is able to
institute frequent disturbances. His political
offences are therefore attempts to restore
a monarchy and the Manchu Regime, creation of
disturbances, selling of country, etc. while his
moral offences are to overthrow morality,
to make all people to behave like animals.
The fact that he is a danger is above all
his offences.

Anyone who commits one of the above 10
offences is despised by others and inexcusable
by law. He often speaks of his being elected
by the people to the presidency, but as a
matter of fact he occupies the position illegally.
How can he be called President so long as he is
the source of all internal troubles? People
elect their President because they expect he
would carry out their wishes. His qualifica-
tions as a President are only that of a
national thief and his leadership of the
country is but that of robbers and thieves.
The people have never elected him to the presi-
dency, but he continues to claim that he was
elected by the people despite the fact that
the people look upon him as their most hated
enemy owing to his offences which are piled up
like a mountain. In one of his telegrams he
said that Fengtien troops have entered Shanhaikwan,
the Chili troops were advancing, fighting was expec-
ted at any moment, the country will be
menaced and nation endangered. It must be under-
stood that all these troubles are the result of
Hsu's prolonged plot. He has now fulfilled his
wish. He was the man who instigated the Chili-
Anfu outbreak, who incited Nyi Sz Tsong to
revolt, who ordered Cheng Hsun to restore the
pages.zh:
追随者都是狡猾之徒，而徐世昌的追随者都是无耻之人。在汉代，风俗淳朴，人类道德受到高度尊重和 uphold，但在邹明图（音译）(一个叛国大臣) 鼓励人们不知羞耻之后，大多数人变得像动物一样。这种情况持续了七八百年，直到宋朝开始恢复人类道德的尊严。徐世昌曾是清朝的朝廷官员，如今却无耻地掌握着民国的权力。他是一个坏贼，狡猾奸诈。他进入政界 merely 靠的是运气和贿赂。他不在乎道德、羞耻或尊严。他从内阁图书馆偷窃书籍，并设立烟酒公卖局作为他的“财政办公室”。他卖官鬻爵，来者不拒地收钱。内阁中有二十个“听差”的空缺从未填补，但其400美元的薪水却被他领走。他比贩卖西海宫所养之鱼的冯国璋更糟糕。他能够制造频繁的动荡。因此，他的政治罪行是试图恢复君主制和满清政权、制造动荡、出卖国家等，而他的道德罪行则是颠覆道德，使所有人都表现得像动物一样。
他对国家的危险事实高于他所有的罪行。

任何人犯下上述10项罪行中的一项都会受人鄙视，且法律不容宽恕。他经常声称自己是经人民选举成为总统的，但事实上他是非法占据该职位。只要他是所有内部动乱的根源，怎么能称他为总统呢？人民选举总统是因为期望他能实现他们的愿望。他作为总统的资格仅仅是国贼，他对国家的领导不过是强盗和小偷的行径。人民从未选举他担任总统，但他继续声称自己是经人民选举产生的，尽管由于他的罪行堆积如山，人民视他为最痛恨的敌人。在他的一份电报中，他说奉军已进入山海关，直军正在推进，战斗随时可能爆发，国家将受到威胁，民族将处于危险之中。必须明白，所有这些麻烦都是徐世昌长期阴谋的结果。他现在实现了他的愿望。他是煽动直皖爆发的人，是唆使倪嗣冲叛乱的人，是命令张勋复辟的

pages.en:
monarchy, who instigated Wu Pei Fu to overthrow
Tuan Chi Jui, who then advised Chang Tso Lin
to fight against Wu Pei Fu, who utilized the
services of Liang Shih Yi to overthrow Chin
Yun Peng, and who again obtained Wu Pei Fu's
support to overthrown Liang Shih Yi. He was
the sole cause of the Fengtien-Chili fight,
and of the internal strifes in the7th and
8th year of the Republic. Hsu Shih Chang is
therefore the head of all disastrous persons
and the leader of many thousands of evils.
His offences are enumerated above. If Hsu
Shih Chang lives one day longer, it can be
said that China will have no able man. We
wish all fellow citizens to wipe off our shame.
pages.zh: 君主制的人，是煽动吴佩孚推翻段祺瑞的人，随后又建议张作霖对抗吴佩孚的人，是利用梁士诒推翻靳云鹏的人，以及再次获得吴佩孚支持以推翻梁士诒的人。他是奉直战争以及民国第七年和第八年内乱的唯一原因。因此，徐世昌是所有灾祸人物的首恶，是万千罪恶的魁首。他的罪行已在上文列举。如果徐世昌多活一天，可以说中国就没有能人了。我们希望所有同胞洗刷我们的耻辱。
